verdict.rationale: Evidence covers transfers, FX, webhooks, and multi-currency wallets, but there is no mention of automated auto top-up between accounts or low-balance alert features anywhere in the docs. Webhooks could theoretically be used to build custom alerts, but no native low-balance alert or auto top-up capability is documented. Missing for 10: auto top-up rules between accounts, low-balance threshold alerts, any treasury automation feature.
